recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中，大量血小板緊密圍繞兩顆嗜中性球（中間偏帶狀核），像花環一樣黏附於細胞膜外，旁邊還有一顆小淋巴球，是典型的血小板衛星現象。
features: Dozens of normal-sized granular platelets rimming the outer membrane of a band neutrophil
Adjacent segmented neutrophil also partly encircled by platelets
Platelets are external to the neutrophil cytoplasm, not phagocytosed
Small mature lymphocyte nearby without adherent platelets
Few free platelets in the surrounding field; red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows numerous normal-sized, well-granulated platelets adherent to the external surface of a band neutrophil and an adjacent segmented neutrophil, forming a rosette. A nearby small lymphocyte shows no platelet adherence. Free platelets are sparse elsewhere, and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts.

ddx.vs: ITP shows true platelet paucity without platelets adhering around neutrophils.
Clumps are free aggregates of platelets not bound to leukocyte surfaces, often accompanying but separate from satellitism.

ddx.dx: Leukocyte with phagocytosed platelets or bacteria
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed material lies inside the cytoplasm within vacuoles, whereas satellites line the outer cell margin.
